preconditions.expression: isinstance(grid, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The input grid is a list of lists.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(grid) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid is square, i.e., each row has the same number of columns as the number of rows.
The size of the grid is between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= cell <= 1000 for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid contains an integer cost between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer.
The minimum cost is at least the number of cells in the grid, each with a minimum cost of 1.
The maximum possible cost is the number of cells in the grid, each with a maximum cost of 1000.
